user.title: Add traffic-aware route
user.description: Create one route. Origin and destination can be an entity_id with latitude/longitude attributes (for example zone.home, person.someone or device_tracker.car) or static coordinates in latitude,longitude format.

data_description.route_name: A unique name, for example Home → Work or Car → Home.
data_description.access_token: Public Mapbox access token (usually starts with pk.).
data_description.origin: Entity ID or latitude,longitude. Dynamic entities are resolved on every update.
data_description.destination: Entity ID or latitude,longitude. Dynamic entities are resolved on every update.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Mapbox
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a valid Mapbox access token.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Mapbox or retrieve the route.
error.invalid_auth: The Mapbox access token is invalid or not authorized.
error.invalid_location: Origin or destination is invalid or does not expose latitude/longitude.

abort.already_configured: A route with this name is already configured.

init.title: Mapbox Travel Time options
init.description: Configure polling and logging. 300 seconds equals 5 minutes.

data.log_successful_updates: Log every successful update at INFO level
